articles.summary: This month, we’re recognizing Giovanna Anzola, Growth Retention Lead at Ridery. Born out of a mission to provide reliable urban mobility during a time of severe economic hardship and national fuel shortages, Ridery launched as Caracas's first mobility app. Today, the platform provides critical livelihoods for over 100,000 workers across the country and has successfully mobilized over 3 million Venezuelans.

articles.summary: Braze has been named a Leader in the inaugural edition of the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Email Marketing Platforms. This assessment looked at a range of different email marketing platforms and reviewed them on their ability to meet different evaluation criteria such as customer experience, market understanding, innovation, and more. We believe that this placement reflects the Braze platform’s ability to support exceptional email marketing programs and our ongoing work to uplevel what’s possible with email engagement, including through the use of data, AI, and personalization.
